journey.title: From Idea to Premiere in 3 Simple Beats
journey.subtitle: No crew required. No multi-month production schedules. You direct the vision, CineForge executes every technical layer.

steps.label: Prompt & Direct
steps.description: Describe your film concept. CineForge structures it into a shot-by-shot cinematic screenplay with character dialogue and camera pacing.

steps.label: Cast & Voice
steps.description: Generate unique characters with persistent visual memory across all scenes, then match them with studio-quality neural actor voices.

steps.label: Render & Master
steps.description: AI animates every shot with cinematic motion, burns synchronized subtitles, normalizes loudness to -16 LUFS, and renders a 24fps master film.

studioStages.title: Five Specialized Studio Departments
studioStages.subtitle: Click through each stage to explore how CineForge orchestrates the entire filmmaking pipeline.

stages.name: Screenplay Studio
stages.headline: From a 1-Line Concept to an Industry Screenplay
stages.description: Transform raw creative prompts into fully realized screenplays. CineForge automatically plans scenes, shot counts, camera angles, and character dialogue allocations timed for cinematic pacing.
stages.directorControl: Review the full script, request tone revisions, or adjust shot pacing with natural conversational feedback.

stages.name: Casting Studio
stages.headline: Characters with Unbreakable Visual Memory
stages.description: Never worry about shifting faces or changing costumes. Every character is designed with persistent visual continuity across lighting, wardrobe, and emotional expressions.
stages.directorControl: Approve characters individually, upload custom reference photos, or re-generate specific actors with targeted feedback.

stages.name: Soundstage
stages.headline: Cast Nuanced, Expressive Neural Actors
stages.description: Assign distinct vocal identities for every character in your ensemble. CineForge balances emotional delivery, pitch, and pacing to match dialogue lines to shot timing.
stages.directorControl: Preview dialogue tracks per shot, swap voice profiles, or adjust delivery cadence with instant preview.

stages.name: Cinematography
stages.headline: Multi-Shot Parallel Cinematic Rendering
stages.description: Turn keyframe designs into fluid, cinematic video clips. High-definition camera movements, depth of field, and dramatic lighting are generated in parallel without waiting in line.
stages.directorControl: Review each rendered shot in full resolution. Re-take any single shot without re-rendering the rest of the film.

stages.name: Master Timeline
stages.headline: Automated Concat, Subtitles & Broadcast Mastering
stages.description: Individual shots are seamlessly stitched into a unified master film with broadcast-standard EBU R128 (-16 LUFS) loudness, custom intro/credits cards, and sample-accurate subtitles.
stages.directorControl: Passes automated freeze, loop, and silence QC checks. Watch the master cut or download high-bitrate MP4.

superpowers.title: Built for Filmmakers Who Want Complete Creative Control
superpowers.subtitle: Everything you need to produce cinematic content without technical friction.

list.title: Visual Continuity Engine
list.description: Characters look like themselves across every scene. No morphing faces or random outfit swaps.

list.title: Zero-Glitch Quality Gate
list.description: Automated MediaValidator verifies zero frozen frames, video loops, or silent dropouts before final delivery.

list.title: Targeted Re-takes
list.description: Dislike shot 3? Don't re-render the entire film. Change the camera direction or prompt for that exact shot only.

list.title: Broadcast Soundstage
list.description: Audio is mastered to industry -16 LUFS loudness with distinct vocal separation and crisp intelligibility.

list.title: Parallel Multi-Shot Engine
list.description: Shots render concurrently, turning multi-scene productions into fast minutes instead of hours.

list.title: 100% Commercial Ownership
list.description: Export watermark-free, high-definition videos with full rights for commercial distribution.
